note: The alate is unknown; type locality Beliapatam, North Malabar, Kerala, India.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: The holotype soldier is deposited in the Forest Research Institute (FRI), Dehradun, India; type locality Beliapatam, North Malabar, Kerala, India. The soldier head is phragmotic (used to plug the gallery opening), thick and almost rectangular, with the frons forming an angle greater than 90° with the mandibles; the postmentum is short and inflated, with a sharp notch on the posterior margin, which distinguishes the species from the other species of the genus. Distribution: Kerala, India.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Anterior part of the head capsule black; antennae, labrum and body pale yellowish brown; anterior margin of the pronotum brown; mandibles black. Head and body sparsely hairy. Body length 4.0—4.7 mm. Head capsule thick, almost rectangular, phragmotic, slightly longer than wide (length to the mandibular base 1.10—1.17 mm, width 1.10—1.13 mm); frontal ridge weak; frons incurved, forming an angle greater than 90° with the mandibles; vertex weakly concave in the middle behind the frontal ridge; epicranial suture present; both tubercles present, the upper thicker and longer, the lower short and narrow. Eye spot paler than the head, situated slightly behind the antennal socket. Anteclypeus pale yellow, narrow, band-like, hairless; postclypeus as dark as the frons, hardly separable from it. Labrum almost triangular, broad at the base; length 0.08—0.13 mm, width 0.13—0.20 mm; with a pair of small setae at the tip. Mandibles short, thick, triangular, pointed at the tip (length 0.31—0.37 mm); the base above the outer condyle weakly raised; each with 2 small, indistinct marginal teeth. Postmentum short and inflated, posterior lateral angles rounded, posterior margin with a sharp notch; slightly incurved in front. Pronotum as wide as the head, flat, anterior margin slightly raised; length 0.66—0.70 mm, width 1.00—1.02 mm; middle of the anterior margin broadly and deeply concave; sides rounded; posterior margin bowed outwards, without a notch. Mesonotum narrower, metanotum as wide as the pronotum. Legs short, thick, hairy; apical tibial spur formula 3:3:3; tarsi 4-segmented. Abdomen elongate, sparsely hairy; cerci 2-segmented; styli not segmented.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Pseudoworker: head yellowish brown; antennae, labrum, legs and body pale yellow. Head capsule almost circular; length to the mandibular base 0.87—0.90 mm, width 0.87—0.90 mm. Eye spot pale, broadly oval, greatest diameter 0.10—0.13 mm. Antennae 12—13-segmented; segment 2 slightly shorter than segment 1; segment 3 shorter than segment 2; segment 4 shortest. Anteclypeus thin, narrow, hairless; postclypeus flat, with several setae, anterior margin slightly bowed outwards.
